description: Godot JVM GDExtension. Support Kotlin, Java and Scala.

latest_release.body:
Godot-JVM first stable release is finally here.
It took a long time but we are happy to say now that the JVM can fully be exploited on Godot using Kotlin, Java and Scala and as a GDExtension, so you can use the official Godot builds with it.

Of course this is not the end and many more features are left to come, mostly focused on the tooling around it. And probably plenty of bugs that will be reported and fixed little by little. But for now it's plenty enough to be considered production-ready.


You can now finally update your existing project to the dear version number 1.0.0:
```kotlin
plugins {
    id("com.utopia-rise.godot-jvm") version "1.0.0"
}
```

# Godot-JVM ## JVM binding for the Godot Game Engine

[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/github/license/utopia-rise/godot-jvm?style=for-the-badge)](LICENSE) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/675058327088136212?style=for-the-badge&label=Discord)](https://discord.gg/zpb5Ru7v9x) [![Website](https://img.shields.io/website?url=https%3A%2F%2Fgodot-jvm.dev%2Fen%2F1.0%2F&style=for-the-badge&label=Documentation)](https://godot-jvm.dev/en/1.0/) ## Overview Godot-JVM lets you write [Godot](https://godotengine.org/) game and application logic in Kotlin, Java, or Scala. Install the GDExtension addon to use the JVM bindings with the official Godot editor and export templates. Explore these example projects: - [Godot-JVM project template](https://github.com/utopia-rise/godot-jvm-project-template) - [Godot-JVM 3D demo](https://github.com/utopia-rise/godot-jvm-3d-demo) ### Code Distribution Distribute desktop games as JARs with an embedded JRE, so players do not need to install Java. Alternatively, compile your JVM code into a native library with the [GraalVM native-image workflow](https://godot-jvm.dev/en/1.0/build/export/graalvm-native-image/). ## Status Godot-JVM is production-ready. We welcome suggestions and feedback to keep improving the project and its API. ## Install Use Godot 4.7 or newer and JDK 17 or newer. Download the addon archive from the [GitHub releases page](https://github.com/utopia-rise/godot-jvm/releases) and extract it into your project's root directory. The resulting layout must contain `addons/jvm/jvm.gdextension`. Open the project with the release's minimum Godot version or newer. ## Documentation Follow [Start here](https://godot-jvm.dev/en/1.0/start/) to set up a project and run your first script. Continue through the guides for everyday development and the reference for detailed rules and settings. ## Community and contributing Join us on our [Discord](https://discord.gg/zpb5Ru7v9x) server to ask questions and work together with a friendly community. If you want to contribute to the project, please read through the [contribution guidelines](https://godot-jvm.dev/en/1.0/contribute/) and the [setup](https://godot-jvm.dev/en/1.0/contribute/build-from-source/) sections. ## Partners JetBrains supports the project by providing development tools to maintainers. IntelliJ IDEA is the supported IDE for Godot-JVM development. ## Special thanks Thanks to the [MOE](https://multi-os-engine.org/) community for helping bring Godot-JVM to iOS.
